name: fanout-research
description: Three explorers look for the answer to one question in the code, the documents and the tests at the same time; one summariser answers from what they found.

agents.task:
Find what the source code of {{folder}} says about this question. Read only; quote file and line for every fact you report.

Question: {{input}}

Find what the documents of {{folder}} say about this question: README, docs, CLAUDE.md, comments at the top of files. Read only; quote file and line for every fact you report.

Question: {{input}}

Find what the tests and the build files of {{folder}} say about this question. Read only; quote file and line for every fact you report.

Question: {{input}}
